lines.en: I shuffle along, my head hollow.
The barrel on my back sloshes.
Something glows beneath my skin.

lines.zh: 重的那只手臂把我拽偏。
lines.en: The heavier arm pulls me sideways.
The air around me has gone sour.
I head toward warmth.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方落下一层灰。
lines.en: A layer of dust settles where I pass.

lines.zh: 我嘴里有什么东西在动。
lines.en: Something moves in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我从毒化洞穴的深处出来。
lines.en: I come up from the poisoned cave's depth.

lines.zh: 墙上的苔被我的指头刮掉。
lines.en: My fingers scrape the moss off the wall.

lines.zh: 我的头歪着，嘴里全是辐射。
lines.en: My head tilts; my mouth is full of radiation.
I go around that ore.
I stand still while the barrel sloshes.

lines.zh: 舌尖上挂着绿色的口水。
lines.en: Green drool hangs from the tip of my tongue.
I listen to water dripping in the cave.
They clutch at the air on their own.
I can't remember anything.
One of my arms is longer than the other.

lines.zh: 脖子里的骨头一节节响。
lines.en: The bones in my neck click one joint at a time.
This cave is close and sweet.
The barrel on my back grows heavier.
I'm licking my own hand.

lines.zh: 你身上有热气，辐射也藏不住。
lines.en: You give off heat; the radiation betrays it.
My head stays tilted at you.
You're four blocks from me.
My tongue is out.
I drag myself half a step closer.
You're starting to smell wrong too.
I don't know you.
Radiation stretched my tongue long.
Don't touch what's on my back.
We're just close enough.

lines.zh: 我晃了一下，桶里的东西洒了。
lines.en: I lurch and the barrel spills.
Only the wound has started turning green.
The barrel strap knocks against stone, loud.
My skin has split a little.
I look down.
I cough up green fluid.
I put my tongue out again.
I clamp a hand on my shoulder.
I will give this back to you.
My legs still work.

lines.zh: 你手里那块腐肉，我认得。
lines.en: That rotten flesh in your hand, I recognize it.
My nose stopped working long ago.

lines.zh: 我嚼两下就咽了，没尝出味。
lines.en: Two chews and I swallow; I taste nothing.
It feels like swallowing a stone.
It tastes bitter in my mouth.
Green or rotten, it all goes into my mouth.
You've brought out another one.
I can't get this down.

lines.zh: 我的长舌头，四格外就够到你。
lines.en: My long tongue reaches beyond four blocks.
Even after eating, I'm still hungry.
You hit my arm.
What you hit is glowing hide.
My hand closed on you.
That sweet smell will linger for twenty seconds.
We pressed together once.
Some of the barrel spilled.
The barrel shifted.
I'm not hostile; I'm only poisonous.

lines.zh: 我的长舌头，够得到四格外。
lines.en: My long tongue reaches past four blocks.
I push past you and keep walking.
I can't find a second shadow.
I can't remember anyone.
Perhaps there was someone before.
I'm not looking, and not waiting.
There's a shape deep inside.
It has no face either.

lines.zh: 两块发光的皮贴得很近。
lines.en: Two glowing hides press close together.
It glows too.
Neither of us can say anything.
Neither looked back, neither remembered.
I cup it in my palm.

lines.zh: 桶的重量，我记在账上了。
lines.en: I've noted the weight of that barrel.
My teeth won't go through it.
I can't describe the taste.

lines.zh: 桶里的味道让我放下它。
lines.en: The smell of the barrel makes me drop it.
I pick it up again.
My hands can't hold anything steady.
A barrel of nuclear waste rides my back.
I tuck it under my tongue.
I keep nothing.
There's a sound behind the cave wall.
My tongue goes out first.
Its smell is in my mouth.
It's more than four blocks off.
I put my tongue out first.

lines.zh: 我背上的废料桶在响，皮下发着光。
lines.en: The waste drum on my back rattles; my skin glows.
Beyond four blocks, my tongue arrives first.
My arm reaches out first.
In the reek of radiation, it hasn't noticed.
The root of my tongue is pulled straight.
My tongue can reach it.
The scent from four blocks away arrives first.
I've curled around it.
I won't let go.

lines.zh: 长舌伸出去，四格外也够。
lines.en: My long tongue reaches past four blocks.
I shuffle after it.
My tongue stays out.
It's backed to the rock wall.
Half a block closer.
The smell is thickening.

lines.zh: 肿起来的那只，拖在地上。
lines.en: The swollen one drags along the ground.
It raised a hand.
I duck my head.
What's in the barrel is sloshing.
I wait for it to stop.

lines.zh: 它每退一步，我的手臂就长一截。
lines.en: Each step it retreats, my arm reaches further.
I'm nearly touching it.
One more reach will do.
My tongue coils in a ring inside my mouth.
Radiation coats my tongue.
I curl my tongue tight.

lines.zh: 四格外用舌头，近了就用手臂。
lines.en: Beyond four blocks I use tongue; closer, arms.
I won't lose its position.
My tongue lashes it.
I bring my arm down.

lines.zh: 这一下你被推出了好几格。
lines.en: That throws you several blocks.
A scorched mark is left on it.
I grab its shoulder.
My fingers sink in.

lines.zh: 手指从它的甲片上滑开。
lines.en: My fingers slide off its armor plate.

lines.zh: 舌根还缠在它的脚踝上。
lines.en: The root of my tongue still circles its ankle.
The barrel on my back is swinging.
I put my tongue out again.
It's driven to its knees.
The air is full of dust.
My arm is clicking.
I close one more step.
It's still trying to get up.

lines.zh: 另一只手臂从上面落下。
lines.en: My other arm comes down from above.

lines.zh: 我的脚步声在毒雾里发闷。
lines.en: My footsteps sound muffled in the toxic fog.
The barrel on my back sloshes from the start.
The air here is sweet and poisonous.
First I sweep my eyes around.
My knuckles scrape the gravel on the cave floor.
Warm, still moving, up ahead.
I move slowly that way.
Green light glows on the cave walls.
I start to drool.
My long tongue reaches four blocks.
I don't remember anything.
I head for the nearest sound.
Something pulses under my skin.

lines.zh: 我朝暖和的石头那边去。
lines.en: I head for the warm stones.

lines.zh: 火烧到我的皮，冒着绿烟。
lines.en: Fire hits my skin and green smoke rises.

lines.zh: 我从石台上摔下去，骨头响。
lines.en: I fall from the rock shelf and my bones crack.

lines.zh: 毒水呛进来，我的舌头还在动。
lines.en: Poison water floods in, and my tongue keeps working.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我背上的桶打翻了。
lines.en: The blast spills the barrel on my back.

lines.zh: 箭插进我的胸口，我没拔。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my chest and I don't pull it.

lines.zh: 那股光让我头里的东西乱跳。
lines.en: That light makes the thing in my head thrash.
I'm so hungry I lick the stones.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，我背上的桶亮了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes me and the barrel glows.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我一路翻下去。
lines.en: The floor is gone and I tumble down.
